attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The output copies the briefing's section headings ('News since your last bulletin:', 'Already reported in your earlier bulletins:') into the bulletin, which breaks character. It also openly re-presents old news under its own label. The wry asides are serviceable but flat ('it is what it is'), and no specific claims are invented."}
